structured.feedback: Meets the core requirements: Markdown with subheadings, roughly 200 words, no links, no fabricated quotes, reviews only lightly cited, and a clear call to action. Minor issues: a few passive constructions ("Built from," "is backed by") despite the active-voice requirement, an invented usage scenario (one pick at home, one in the bag, one in the car), and features and benefits are not explicitly labeled as the prompt asked.
